findings.title: order() mixin off-by-one for legacy box ordinal-group
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss the order($val) mixin emits -webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val and -moz-box-ordinal-group: $val with the same value as order: $val. The legacy box ordinal-group is 1-indexed while flex order is 0-indexed, so the legacy value must be $val + 1. As written, any use such as @include order(3) or order(2) renders one position earlier in old WebKit/Firefox than in modern browsers, causing inconsistent header/extra-info ordering.

findings.title: align-items() emits invalid -ms-align-items property
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss the align-items mixin outputs -ms-align-items: $alignment, which is not a real CSS property (IE10 uses only -ms-flex-align). It also passes values like center/baseline straight to -webkit-box-align and -ms-flex-align, which do not support the full modern keyword set. This produces dead declarations and unpredictable vertical alignment in legacy browsers for callers in header.scss, topic-post.scss and badges.css.scss.

findings.title: Removed float fallback breaks header in non-flex browsers
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/header.scss .panel changed from float: right to only margin-left: auto plus order(3), and .title float: left was deleted. margin-left: auto only pushes right inside a flex container; in any browser without flexbox support the panel collapses to the left and title styling is lost. The old floats should be kept before the flexbox declarations as a fallback.

findings.title: float:right on flex item is ignored, button misaligned
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss .small-action was made a flex container via flexbox() but its children still use floats, including button { float: right; }. Float is ignored on flex items per spec, so the dismiss button will sit directly after .small-action-desc instead of at the far right, and clear: both / float: left on siblings are likewise dead. A flex alignment such as margin-left: auto or justify-content is needed to preserve the old right-aligned layout.
